subject: angol
title: Learning at any age
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a tanulásról, a vizsganyomásról és az egész életen át tartó tanulásról.

scenes.description: It is ten o'clock at night, and a seventeen-year-old girl is sitting at the desk in her bedroom. She is having an online maths lesson with a private tutor, who appears on her laptop screen. Around her there are piles of practice tests, highlighters and an empty energy drink can. She is rubbing her eyes and looks exhausted.

In a bright classroom at a community centre, about ten adults of different ages, from their twenties to their seventies, are attending an evening Spanish course. Two of them, a young man in a suit and a grey-haired woman, are doing a role-play at a pretend café counter, and the rest of the group are laughing. The teacher is clapping. Nobody seems to be under pressure.

prompts: Compare the two learning situations and the feelings of the learners.
Why do so many Hungarian students take private lessons?
What motivates people to keep learning as adults?
followUpQuestions: Is it ever too late to learn a new language or skill? Why?
Does the school system put too much pressure on teenagers? In what way?
How could schools prepare students better for exams without private tutors?
What would you like to learn later in life, just for fun?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures are about learning, but the situations and the learners' feelings are very different. In the first one, it's late at night and a teenage girl is having an online maths lesson with a private tutor. She's surrounded by practice tests and an empty energy drink can, and she looks absolutely exhausted – I guess she's preparing for the school-leaving exam. The second picture shows an evening Spanish course for adults of all ages at a community centre. Two of them are doing a role-play at a pretend café, and everyone is laughing.
The biggest difference is pressure. The girl is learning because she has to, while the adults are learning because they want to. Unfortunately, the first scene is very familiar in Hungary. Lots of students take private lessons, partly because classes are big and teachers don't have time for everyone, and partly because exam results decide which university you get into. Adults, on the other hand, are usually motivated by curiosity, travel or their careers, which makes learning far more enjoyable.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Is it ever too late to learn a new language or skill? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I don't think so. My grandmother started learning English at sixty-five so that she could chat with my aunt's family in Canada, and now she can have simple conversations. It may take longer, but motivation matters more than age.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: a két jelenet leírása után az összehasonlítás egy kulcsfogalomra (a nyomásra) épül, a vizsgázó két okkal magyarázza a magánórák népszerűségét Magyarországon, kitér a felnőttek motivációjára, a visszakérdezésnél pedig családi példát hoz.
Szókincs: pontos, témához illő szavak (private tutor, practice tests, community centre, role-play, curiosity) és jó kötőszavak (partly because …, and partly because …; on the other hand).

Nyelvhelyesség: B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – a 'because she has to … because they want to' párhuzam, 'so that she could' célhatározói mellékmondat és a mondatra visszautaló 'which makes learning far more enjoyable'.
Érdemes megtanulni: „she looks absolutely exhausted”, „The biggest difference is pressure”, „partly because … and partly because …”, „motivation matters more than age”.
